tips.heading: Application tips
tips.tip1: Tailor your CV to the job title and key requirements. SA employers often screen by keyword.
tips.tip2: Include your ID number or work-permit status if the ad requests it; omitting it is a common rejection reason.
tips.tip3: Keep your cover letter under one page and open with a sentence on why this specific role, not a generic greeting.

stepA.intro: Copy these details exactly from the job advertisement. They appear verbatim on page 1 of your Z83.
stepA.availHint: e.g. “Immediately” or “1 calendar month notice period”
stepA.positionError: Enter the full position title (at least 5 characters)
stepA.departmentError: Enter the full department name (at least 5 characters)
stepA.refNoError: Enter a valid reference number (e.g. DPSA 01/2026/01)
stepA.availError: Enter your availability or notice period (at least 5 characters)

stepB.nameHint: Surname first in capitals, then first names — e.g. DLAMINI Thabo Sipho
stepB.nameError: Enter surname and full names (must include letters)
stepB.idHint: 13 digits. Leave blank if using a passport.
stepB.idError: SA ID number must be exactly 13 digits
stepB.passportError: Enter a valid passport number (e.g. A12345678)
stepB.demographicsHint: Required by the Z83 for equity reporting purposes.
stepB.citizenQuestion: Are you a South African citizen?
stepB.workPermitQuestion: Do you have a valid work permit?

stepC.noticePrimary: These answers are never saved — not even when you are signed in.
stepC.noticeSecondary: Criminal record, disciplinary history, and business-interest disclosures are treated as sensitive by design. They are cleared when you close this tab and must be re-entered each session.
stepC.q1: Have you been convicted of a criminal offence?
stepC.q1Detail: Provide details — nature of the offence, date, and sentence imposed
stepC.q2: Do you have any pending criminal charges against you?
stepC.q2Detail: Provide details of the pending charges
stepC.q3: Have you been dismissed from employment due to misconduct in the last 5 years?
stepC.q3Detail: Provide details — employer, date, and nature of misconduct
stepC.q4: Are there any pending disciplinary proceedings against you?
stepC.q4Detail: Provide details of the pending proceedings
stepC.q5: Have you resigned from employment while disciplinary proceedings were pending against you?
stepC.q5Detail: Provide details — employer, position, date, and nature of proceedings
stepC.q6: Have you been discharged from the public service on grounds of ill health?
stepC.q7: Do you conduct business with the state, or are you a director of a company that conducts business with the state?
stepC.q7Detail: Provide details — nature of the business and name of the state entity
stepC.q8: If appointed, will you relinquish those business interests?
stepC.q9: Were you previously employed in the public service?
stepC.q9Hint: Includes national or provincial government, municipalities, and state entities.
stepC.q9Detail: Provide details — department, period of employment, reason for leaving

stepD.profRegDateHint: Year registered with your professional body
stepD.langHint: Up to 5 languages. The Z83 PDF prints proficiency columns (Read / Write / Speak / Understand) for the first two rows only.
stepD.errContactShort: Address too short — include street, suburb, and postal code

stepE.qualsHint: Up to 4 rows. List highest qualification first.
stepE.currentHint: Leave blank if not currently studying.
stepE.errText: At least 3 characters and must include a letter

stepF.workHint: Up to 3 entries. List most recent first. Leave the To fields blank for your current position.
stepF.refsHint: Up to 3 professional references. Use office hours telephone numbers.
stepF.errText: At least 3 characters and must include a letter
stepF.errTel: Enter a valid phone number (at least 9 digits)

stepPreview.descPrimary: The Z83 requires your initials at the foot of each page and your full signature on the declaration section of page 2. Draw in the boxes below — they are printed directly onto the PDF.
stepPreview.descSecondary: All three are optional for the download; leave blank if you intend to sign the printed copy by hand.
stepPreview.dateErr: Format must be day, month name, year — e.g. 14 September 2026
stepPreview.dateHint: Enter the date as it should appear on the form — e.g. 14 September 2026
